_doc: 物理响应主配置（2026-09-29 定案）。make_trial_root.py --release-config 由此生成 experiment.json；families_by_game 按 moe_chars 的 game 前缀展开到每个角色，优先级高于 families_by_character。mesh_overrides_by_character 是候选暂存路径，不进主配置。 mesh_overrides_by_character / head_sources_by_character：9 个发布角色的表情修正头（09-29），发布 canonical 不可变，所以放在 work/fx_heads_20260929，路径相对仓库根。
tuning_basis: bone-lock A/B: accessory, skirt, cloth, ribbon HF regressions; hair/ear/sleeve/soft_body/tail held at prior values; compliant contacts 60 Hz critically damped (sitting/shock skirt jitter sweep); user: motion above 0.5 Hz reads as jitter -> overdamped drives (ratio x3 capped 4.5, half-life /2); tep lantern (acc_R_Gadget_a) no longer collides with skirt/tail (user-named lantern-skirt jitter); user: depenetration graded by penetration depth -- <=0.1 deep push-out capped at 1, >=0.4 at 10 (max), linear between; zero-phase low-pass 1.5Hz on physics-bone local channels after solve (user: >0.5Hz reads as jitter); depth thresholds lowered to 0.03/0.15 (lin idle tail stuck-then-snap at 0.1/0.4: 4/8 replicas jumped, 0/8 after; cyu sitting still 0 tunnelled); hair family reverted to pre-overdamping values (user: lin hair lags in dance_spin and tangles in sitting; >2Hz hair jitter left to the write-back low-pass); hair spring 2.5/1.6 -> 20/13 Hz root/tip (user: hairstyles deform, too soft; 4-role test sha/kse/lit/chr idle sag p95 59-91 -> 16-22 deg, >2Hz jitter <=0.02 deg); ribbon added to solver twist-lock families (sab/jia/sha strap-belt 168-177 deg one-frame twist flips); ear and accessory springs 8/5.5 Hz (tan ear 33 -> 1.2 deg >2Hz on 8-role test); endfield-only softening (families_by_game.endfield): hair 4/2.5 Hz, tail ratio 1.2, ear 3/2 Hz (user: endfield hair/tail/ear too stiff; SOFT1 on 8 roles, sway +30~180%, >2Hz jitter max hair 1.2->1.4)
